cases.question: During a frost drill, under what temperature condition and for how long must valve C stay closed?

source.text: During a frost drill, keep valve C closed for 12 minutes only when the outside temperature is below -5 degrees Celsius.

facts.claim: For frost drills, valve C must remain shut for twelve minutes, and this applies only when the outdoor temperature is colder than minus five degrees Celsius.
